sections.title: What goes into a dish
sections.content: recept ("recipe") and hozzávaló ("ingredient") are the two words you need to talk about any dish before you even start cooking. fűszer ("spice, seasoning") covers the flavor side — paprika, bors ("pepper") and só ("salt") are the three you'll reach for constantly in a Hungarian kitchen.

items.spanish: A paprika, a bors és a só fontos fűszerek a konyhában.
items.english: Paprika, pepper, and salt are important spices in the kitchen.

sections.content: hozzávaló looks like a mouthful, but it's built from hozzá ("to it") plus -való ("that is for") — literally "something that goes into it". You don't need to break it apart to use it; just treat it as one word meaning "ingredient".
